findings.title: Delivery failure contracts are not identity-checked by the incomplete-export guard
findings.cause: checked() validates total failure-row count but applies job/callee uniqueness only to ordinary jobs. covers_authored_delivery validates descriptors against the opaque bindings, not the corresponding failure row. The audit subsequently trusts a name-only find and contract.callee.
findings.reproduction: On a fresh healthy analyzed grounded delivery fixture (one finished binding, no ordinary typing.jobs), clone the public AnalyzedProject and mutate only failures.jobs[0].job to orphan_review_job: derive_approval_subject panics at artifacts.rs:276 ('checked job failure completeness'). Mutate only failures.jobs[0].callee to orphan_review_callee: derivation succeeds and emits a job run different from the immutable checked schedule callee. Clearing all failure rows is correctly rejected.
findings.additional_observation: Setting the same row's may_suspend=true also exports successfully. This is payload consistency, not a missing-row bypass; do not treat it as live authority.
findings.impact: The newly claimed checked export-completeness boundary accepts a mismatched ordinary-run failure contract or panics instead of returning a scoped refusal. An orphan row can stand in for an omitted delivery row while preserving total length.
findings.threat_limit: This is a public analyzed-project API corruption/mutation probe, comparable to the new incomplete-export tests. It is not reproduced from normal authored CLI source; fresh analyze_sources gates correctly refuse invalid source and do not create partial bindings.
findings.correction: Validate every authored job's exact unique (job, checked schedule callee) failure contract, including delivery schedules from DeliveryModel, before snapshot/artifact generation. Reject orphan, wrong-callee, duplicate and missing delivery failure rows without panic. If post-analysis payload consistency is part of the immutable checked boundary, retain the checked ordinary-run failure contract in the opaque binding or compare against fresh failure analysis, rather than trusting mutable rows.
